summary: Saves or restores a 3-DWORD position vector based on an activation flag at this+0x9C. When the flag is clear and a2 equals 1, copies the current position (this+0x18, this+0x1C, this+0x20) into the saved slot (this+0x90, this+0x94, this+0x98) and sets the flag to 1. When the flag equals 1 and a2 is 0, VectorCopy restores the three DWORDs from the saved slot to the base position and clears the flag to 0. Called from CameraShake and CollisionResponseWithRandomPerturbation.

operations.description: Read the activation flag byte at this+0x9C and branch: the save path runs only when the flag is clear and a2 equals 1, the restore path only when the flag equals 1 and a2 is 0.
Restore branch: active when the flag at this+0x9C equals 1 and a2 is 0.
VectorCopy copies three DWORDs from the saved position slot at this+0x90 to the base position at this+0x0.
Clear the activation flag at this+0x9C to 0 after restoring the position.
Save X: copy the value at this+0x18 into the saved slot at this+0x90.
Save Y: copy the value at this+0x1C into the saved slot at this+0x94.
Save Z: copy the value at this+0x20 into the saved slot at this+0x98.
Set the activation flag at this+0x9C to 1, marking the position as saved.
Return the last byte value: the flag byte on the save and early-exit paths, or the VectorCopy result on the restore path.

clean_pseudocode: // Save or restore a 3-DWORD position based on the activation flag at +0x9C.
// flag = byte at this+0x9C; saved slot = this+0x90/0x94/0x98; current = this+0x18/0x1C/0x20
VectorCopy(this, this + 0x90);   // saved slot -> base position (3 DWORDs)
unresolved: Owner type and identity of the object that carries the current position, the saved slot and the activation flag are unknown.
The meaning of the two activation states and the exact role of the base position written by VectorCopy depend on the callers CameraShake and CollisionResponseWithRandomPerturbation.
